description: This file defines a CustomLogger class for observability and logging within a larger system, particularly for integrating with Promptlayer and other external systems. It includes methods for logging events, handling callback hooks, redacting sensitive information such as base64 data, and translating request/response formats for various LLMs. The code also supports asynchronous hooks and fallback mechanisms for rate limiting and error handling.

classes.name: CustomLogger
classes.description: A class providing extensive logging and callback hooks, including event logging, format translation, sensitive data redaction, and asynchronous hooks for custom observability, integrated with Promptlayer and other external logging systems.
